name: Greenworks 20222
blurb: 14″ bar, 3/8″ low profile chain, .050″ gauge, 52 drive links (Oregon S52), from Oregon's saw-chain selection guide.
intro: Oregon's saw-chain selection guide gives Greenworks 20222 its own line: Oregon S52, a 14″ bar, 52 drive links, .050″ gauge, 3/8″ low profile. The guide does not print a file size. Oregon's line reads 20012 9A electric and 20222 9A electric.

bars.note: Oregon prints S52 for this model line: 14″ bar, 52 drive links, .050″ gauge, 3/8″ low profile. No file size is printed.

sources.title: Oregon Saw Chain Selection Guide: model line printed with saw-chain code, bar length, drive links, gauge and pitch

sources_note: Oregon Saw Chain Selection Guide (https://apps.oregonproducts.com/pdfs/TSC-Chain-Fit-Guide.pdf), read 9 Nov 2026. The row restates the model line Oregon prints for this saw. Oregon does not print a file size on that line.
